profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Octavio Cruz Ortega. I am a software engineer with expertise in front-end and full-stack development. My focus is on building real-life web applications, REST APIs, and integrations. I have extensive knowledge of JavaScript, Node.js, C++, React, Express, Firebase, Redux, and front-end frameworks.

As a DACA recipient and first-generation student, my journey has been shaped by resilience and determination. Arriving in the U.S. at age 9, I navigated significant challenges to pursue my passion for technology and software development.

I enjoy engaging in problem-solving and implementing popular algorithms from well-known coding platforms. I love creating modern, user-friendly applications that address real-life problems, both in the realm of web apps and hardware.

Overcoming the adversities that come with each project is the most exciting part for me, and achieving the desired results gives me a great sense of accomplishment.

positions.title: Construction Coordinator
positions.description: I have experience as a Construction Coordinator, Lead, and Manager On-site, where I effectively manage construction projects, oversee teams, and ensure client satisfaction through clear communication and efficient project execution.

positions.title: Dairy Department Team Leader
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: As a Dairy Department Supervisor at Whole Foods, I led a team in maintaining organized and well-stocked dairy compartments, ensuring optimal product visibility and accessibility. Implementing inventory management strategies facilitated efficient restocking processes for buyers, thereby ensuring a wide selection of high-quality dairy products for customers.

positions.title: Food Court Team Leader
positions.description: As a Team Leader in the food court department at Costco, I provided leadership and guidance to a team of associates, ensuring smooth operations and exceptional customer service. I effectively delegated tasks, managed workflow, and promoted teamwork to meet productivity targets and maintain efficiency. Additionally, I assisted with inventory management and acted as a point of contact for escalated customer inquiries, resolving conflicts and ensuring customer satisfaction.

educations.degreeName: Associate's Degree in Engineering and Mathematics

projects.title: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform Modeled After Amazon
projects.description: This is a full-stack Amazon clone with front-end and back-end functionality using ReactJS, Webhooks, Stripe Checkout, Firestore, Firebase hosting, and Firebase Google Authentication. The back-end API is built using Node.js with Express, and the server-side functionality is tested locally using Firebase Functions Emulators.

projects.title: Full-Stack Social Media Platform Inspired by Instagram
projects.description: This Instagram clone boasts a fully functional set of features, including user login, following and unfollowing, post creation and deletion, and commenting capabilities. The app utilizes the MERN stack, with JWT for security and password encryption. The home component displays all posts, while the feed only shows posts from followed users.
